description: A neutral monochrome starting profile. The coordinator must inspect source figures and freeze a book-specific profile before dispatch.

font.note: For Chinese labels, configure a locally installed CJK family or supply font file paths. Missing families or label glyphs fail rather than silently substituting fonts.

override_policy: Only coordinator-reviewed spec.style_override values are allowed. Preserve source color when meaningful; do not recolor every figure to match this starter profile.

label_background.note: Keep point labels close and unchanged unless actual overlap occurs. First try directions around the point at fixed gap, then increase gap only if needed. Only unavoidable overlaps receive a small white backing: text.set_gid('label-background:STABLE_ID'). Record placement attempts and reason in scene/self-check; protect nodes, intersections and arrowheads.
